item.title: An Overview of Greek Mythology: Attempting to Appreciate Art Through the Lens of Myth
item.description: From zodiac courses to travels in Greece, from the primordial Chaos to the maturation of Cupid—a non-expert's rough synthesis of the main threads of Greek mythology and the beautiful encounters between myth and art.
